_archived_cost_efficiency.note: Intelligence Index vs blended cost-per-task (USD), pulled from Artificial Analysis' model leaderboard. Scoped to Claude Sonnet & Opus (all reasoning efforts) vs Gemini vs Grok — Zmir's actual shortlist, not the full AA roster. Manually refreshed by pasting a fresh screenshot when numbers move — the page is JS-rendered and not scraped automatically. Entries with "estimated": true weren't in the last screenshot (AA doesn't publish every Claude effort level, and Gemini/Grok rows weren't captured) and are interpolated — see each entry's "estimate_basis". Replace with real numbers next time a screenshot covers them. Not in the composite; this is a separate 'is the extra spend worth it' lens. The dashboard computes the cost/intelligence frontier and flags dominated options client-side.
